business_summary: PharmGen Science, Inc. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of pharmaceutical products in South Korea. It provides prescription drugs, OTC drugs, diagnostic test kits, health and general foods, and cosmetics, as well as shampoo, conditioner, and hair oil products under the neomcell brand name. The company was formerly known as Wooridul Pharmaceutical Limited and changed its name to PharmGen Science, Inc. PharmGen Science, Inc. was founded in 1966 and is headquartered in Hwaseong-si, South Korea.
business_summary_ko: PharmGen Science, Inc.는 한국에서 의약품의 연구 개발, 생산 및 판매에 종사하고 있습니다. 네오셀 브랜드로 처방의약품, 일반의약품, 진단검사 키트, 건강 및 일반식품, 화장품은 물론 샴푸, 컨디셔너, 헤어오일 제품도 제공하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 이전에 우리들제약(Wooridul Pharmaceutical Limited)으로 알려져 있었고, 사명을 PharmGen Science, Inc.로 변경했습니다. PharmGen Science, Inc.는 1966년에 설립되었으며 대한민국 화성에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
